tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page and app background. The default ground for everything.

tokens.name: paper-sunk
tokens.usage: Recessed areas: sidebars, the timeline track, code blocks, table headers.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: trial cards, dialogs, popovers, inputs.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and the t-tail of the logo. Reads on paper, paper-sunk and paper-raised in both themes (12:1 or better).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, helper text, table cells that are not the key value. On paper, paper-sunk, paper-raised.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Placeholders, timestamps, disabled labels. On paper and paper-raised only; on paper-sunk it drops below 4.5:1 in light.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card outlines. Decorative only; never the sole edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Edges of interactive controls: inputs, checkboxes, secondary buttons. Meets 3:1 on paper, paper-sunk and paper-raised.

tokens.name: stimulus
tokens.usage: The brand vermilion: the fixation cross in the logo, the active trial, the playhead, stimulus blocks on the timeline. A graphic colour; never body text (3.35:1 on paper in light).

tokens.name: stimulus-text
tokens.usage: Vermilion when it must be text or a link: active tab labels, inline links. 5:1 on paper in light, 7:1 in dark.

tokens.name: stimulus-fill
tokens.usage: Primary button and selected-pill fill. Always paired with on-stimulus text.

tokens.name: on-stimulus
tokens.usage: Text and icons on stimulus-fill (5:1 light, 5.6:1 dark).

tokens.name: stimulus-tint
tokens.usage: Selected rows, the highlighted trial in a list, drop targets. Text on it is ink or stimulus-text.

tokens.name: mask
tokens.usage: Masks and inter-stimulus intervals on the timeline; the second frame of the loader animation. Graphic only.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Focus rings (2px solid, 2px offset) and success states. Blue-teal so it never competes with stimulus and stays off the red-green axis.

tokens.name: caution
tokens.usage: Warnings: timing that the display refresh rate cannot honour, unsaved changes. Always with a warning icon and a word.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions. Close in hue to stimulus, so ALWAYS pair with an icon and the word (Delete, Error); never colour alone.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Landing and empty-state headlines only. One per screen at most.

styles.name: heading-1
styles.usage: Page titles: the experiment name in the editor header.

styles.name: heading-3
styles.usage: Group titles inside panels and dialogs.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Participants see a fixation cross before each word.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Shown until a key is pressed
styles.usage: Helper text, table cells, plugin descriptions.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase field labels and timeline block types. Uppercase is applied in CSS; write the source text in sentence case.

styles.name: timing
styles.usage: Durations, frame counts, refresh rates, trial counts. Tabular figures.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Plugin names, parameter keys, exported JSON and JavaScript.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, tight inline gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls; button vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Input padding; gap between timeline blocks.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; button horizontal padding; minimum page gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between groups in a panel.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Panel padding on desktop; gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Empty-state and landing vertical rhythm.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Timeline blocks, tags, checkboxes. Square-ish, like a stimulus frame.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, cards, menus.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the app icon tile only.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus and dialogs only. Cards and panels use line, not shadow.

tokens.name: duration-flash
tokens.usage: One stimulus or mask frame of the loader (40% of the 1400ms cycle).

tokens.name: duration-cycle
tokens.usage: Full stimulus, mask, blank cycle of the loader.

tokens.name: duration-ui
tokens.usage: Hover and press transitions. Steps, not eases, for anything that represents a stimulus.
